subject: Post-demo decision playbook & compliance checklist
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@alttab.io>, Sam Simmons <sam.simmons@alttab.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T14:05:00Z
Subject: Post-demo decision playbook & compliance checklist

Hi Claire — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same playbook.

What we covered (2:1 demo):
- Scope: real-time triage assistant for clinical intake forms (EMR agnostic)
- Performance: 95th pct latency target ~120ms on p60 payloads; Redwood can tier between hosted/dedicated for predictable SLOs
- Data controls: VPC private deployment, customer KMS key option, audit logs preserved for 1 year by default

Decision stakeholders you mentioned:
- Claire Jensen — Product (evaluation lead)
- Sam Simmons — Security (technical gate)
- Procurement (email copied below) — contracting and T&Cs
- Economic sponsor: VP of Digital Services (TBD)

Immediate asks (proposed owners & timeline):
1) Security evidence bundle (Redwood -> provide): I attached a short security summary and demo recording. Can provide SOC 2 + architecture diagrams if Sam wants them. [attachment: redwood-security-summary.pdf, demo-recording.mp4]
2) Procurement checklist (Customer -> Redwood): procurement to share standard contract terms and any required PO language. We can prepare a redline within 48 business hours.
3) Pricing & commitment options (Ben -> Claire): I asked Ben to include both reserved Dedicated pricing and Hosted API estimate in the attached MAP.
4) Legal / SSO / Data residency questions (Monica -> Sam & Procurement): Monica will confirm SSO options and data residency patterns for your accounts.

Requested next dates:
- Procurement kick-off: evergreen — can we propose Tue Aug 10 or Wed Aug 11 (30–45 min)?
- Security deep-dive (Sam + infra): Fri Aug 6, 11:00am PT (45 min) — we can bring our infra engineer and solutions PM.

Claire, if you can confirm the procurement contact and VP sponsor name this week we’ll lock dates and handoffs.

Thanks — look forward to moving this to an MAP.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: redwood-security-summary.pdf (1.2MB summary), demo-recording.mp4 (72MB, 12m)
From: Sam Simmons <sam.simmons@alttab.io>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@alttab.io>
Cc: procurement@alttab.io
Date: 2027-08-04T18:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo decision playbook & compliance checklist

Thanks for the concise recap, Ava. A few notes from Security: 

1) Please send SOC 2 Type II report and network diagram showing where logs are retained and who has access. If you can include a sample audit log schema that would help.
2) Data retention: we have a 13-month retention policy; can Redwood align or provide a time-bound retention override per customer?
3) Encryption: confirm if TLS 1.3 + AES-256 at rest + customer-controlled KMS is supported for Private deployments.

Procurement: procurement@alttab.io will start the T&Cs intake — cc'ed. My preference is to see a standard SOW + MSA with explicit uptime SLA and IP indemnity language.

I can make the security deep-dive on Fri Aug 6 at 11:00am PT. Please include an engineer who can discuss KV cache behavior and how we handle cold-starts.

On timing for the economic sponsor: Claire's going to confirm with the VP today.

Sam Simmons
Security Lead, Alttab Health
sam.simmons@alttab.io

Hi Ava / Ben — procurement here. Thanks for the materials. A couple items we need before we can start legal review:

1) Standard PO fields: company legal name, EIN, billing address, and invoicing cadence.
2) Sample commercial terms or a clean MSA to speed internal review. If you have a standard CLIN-based pricing or term sheet that maps to reserved capacity vs pay-as-you-go, send that.
3) Any export controls or cross-border data flow clauses that would impact our EU clinics — we typically flag those in initial review.

Please attach the redlined MSA to the HubSpot deal or send via DocuSign for faster routing. We expect a 7–10 business day lead time after we receive the clean MSA and pricing.

Procurement Team
Alttab Health
procurement@alttab.io

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-06T09:10:00Z
Subject: Internal: Alttab next steps & owners (security + procurement asks)

Team — summary of externally-facing asks and internal owners. Please treat as action items before EOD Thursday.

1) Security bundle (Owner: Monica) — Deliverables: SOC 2 Type II (redacted if needed), network diagram, sample audit-log schema, encryption confirmation. Due: Thu Aug 5 EOD (we should at least share the one-pager and sample schema today and confirm SOC 2 availability). Attachments to include: redwood-security-summary.pdf.

2) Pricing options (Owner: Ben) — Provide 1) Hosted P0 estimate, 2) Dedicated 3-node reserved pricing, and 3) a short sensitivity table showing cost per 1M tokens. Add a short one-paragraph rationale for when to choose Dedicated vs Hosted for their workload. Due: Thu Aug 5 COB.

3) Contract playbook (Owner: Priyom) — Prepare clean MSA + SOW template and a short summary of commercial levers (SLA credits, termination for convenience, data residency clauses). Highlight any redlines we commonly accept and those we escalate to legal. Due: Fri Aug 6 COB.

4) Deep-dive staffing (Owner: Monica/Ben) — Confirm who from infra will join security deep-dive on Fri Aug 6 11:00am PT. Recommend bringing Rahul (infra engineer) and Sandeep (solutions PM).

Notes:
- I uploaded the demo recording and MAP to the deal folder (link in the HubSpot note).
- Ben, please include a short pricing appendix in the MAP so procurement can map quickly.

If anyone thinks deadlines are tight, say so now and I will push timelines back a day. Otherwise I’ll send the internal bundle to Claire/Sam/procurement after we have the first docs.

Thanks — Ava
